name: Natasha, Pierre and The Great Comet of 1812
hours_label: Evenings 7:30 PM, weekend matinees · Tickets from $19
blurb: Dingbat Theatre Project stages the Tony-winning electro-pop opera carved from a slice of Tolstoy's War and Peace, with the company's signature immersive, iconoclastic spin. An intimate black-box production on the South Trail near Gulf Gate. Tickets start at $19; runs through Sept. 13.

name: Shared Light: Lynn Goldsmith at Selby Gardens
venue: Marie Selby Botanical Gardens, Downtown Sarasota Campus
hours_label: Daily 10 AM - 5 PM · $28 adults, $12 ages 5-17, under 4 free
blurb: Final days of Selby Gardens' indoor and outdoor exhibition of Lynn Goldsmith, the celebrated rock-and-roll and nature photographer whose portraits of Patti Smith, Bruce Springsteen and others hang in the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame. Admission includes the bayfront gardens, conservatory and Michael's on the Bay. $28 adults, $12 ages 5-17, members free.

name: Siesta Key Drum Circle
venue: Siesta Beach, south of the pavilion
hours_label: About 1 hour before sunset (roughly 6:45 PM) · Free
blurb: Every Sunday evening hundreds of locals and visitors gather on the quartz sand just south of the Siesta Beach pavilion for a free-form drum circle, dancing and one of the best sunsets on the Gulf. Bring a chair or a drum; no tickets, no cost. It is the most Siesta Key thing you can do on a Sunday.
source: Siesta Key Drum Circle / evergreen weekly anchor

name: Overjoyed: A Stevie Wonder Tribute (Monday Night Jazz)
venue: John C. Court Cabaret, Florida Studio Theatre
hours_label: Doors 6:30 PM, show 7:30 PM · Ticketed (Jazz Club of Sarasota)
blurb: Jazz Club of Sarasota's Monday Night Jazz series brings pianist Richard "STretch" Bruyn and his band Rubberband to FST's intimate Court Cabaret for a night of Stevie Wonder classics, from Superstition to Sir Duke. Doors open at 6:30 PM for dinner and drinks; the show starts at 7:30. Tickets through Jazz Club of Sarasota; an easy Labor Day evening out downtown.
photo_credit: Photo: Jazz Club of Sarasota / Patch

name: Sarasota Bradenton Fall Home Show
venue: Robarts Arena at the Sarasota Fairgrounds
hours_label: Fri & Sat 10 AM – 7 PM, Sun 10 AM – 5 PM · Free with online pass ($10 at door)
blurb: Hundreds of local home-improvement, landscaping, kitchen, bath, window and design pros under one roof at Robarts Arena, with show-only deals and expert advice. A useful stop if you are settling into a new Sarasota home or planning a remodel. Free passes online, $10 at the door, free parking.
photo_credit: Photo: Sarasota Bradenton Home Show / American Consumer Shows
